reviews.title: Exactly what you need!
reviews.comment: Great replacement for my one stick of 16gbs of RAM. Installation is very easy, just make sure you insert them all the way. I made the mistake of not fully inserting them and had trouble booting up my pc. The rgb lights are a great addition to my case. They look great and are functionally better than my last part! Honestly, great part for the money
reviews.author: Juanito

reviews.title: nice kit to go with the same ram that came with my prebuilt for 64gb total
reviews.comment: bought this kit to go with my other 2 sticks of the same ram for a total of 64 gb worked right out of the box speeds are nice the rgb is great really like that i can use software to change it to what ever color i want was easy to install i really like the packaging it came it they even included a sticker i also need to note i havent had any stability problems even though am5 is known to be rough with all ram slots filled it was decent price to i think i paid only 82 bucks for the kit cant complain for a stable upgrade
